name: A False Calm

npcs.name: Lola Teresa
dialogue: Aftershocks have eased, but the coast has gone strangely quiet and the water is drawing away.
That can mean a tsunami is coming. Leave the beach and go to high ground now.
after_dialogue: We are safely uphill. Keep listening for the all-clear from local officials.
rescue_dialogue: I am stranded and need the drinking water. Please bring it, then help me get to the marked route, away from the unstable slope.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. I can follow you to the marked route, away from the unstable slope now.
npcs.rescue_hint: Find the drinking water, then speak with Lola Teresa again.

choice.prompt: The settlement is recovering. What should the team prioritize?

options.text: Restore the warning and radio network
options.result: The community can receive official alerts again.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.text: Send everyone to salvage household goods
options.result: The team loses time while the warning network remains down.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

quests.title: Find a first-aid kit for the evacuation to high ground.
Find Community checklist for the response team

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.community: Find Lola Teresa and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach High Ground / School and stay clear of danger.

lessons: Check in with neighbors and report hazards to local responders.
Avoid damaged buildings and follow local instructions during recovery.
Keep supplies, contact information, and evacuation routes ready.

quiz.question: The disaster has passed, but a building is visibly damaged. What should you do?
options: Keep clear and wait for officials to say it is safe
Ask a child to inspect it
quiz.explanation: Stay away from damaged structures and follow local authority guidance.

briefing: The storm has passed. Help residents repair, check on people rescued earlier, organize supplies, and restore the local warning and communications systems. A coastal monitor behaves strangely, but officials have not issued an evacuation alert yet.
story_clue: For the first time, the community feels safe. The warning station briefly shows inconsistent readings.
